title: Profile and optimize SOGRAND/turbo decoder throughput for n=32 codes
description:
## Problem

With the corrected ORBGRAND (collecting all codewords during the full query sweep), decoder throughput has decreased:
- eBCH(16,11) product code: ~0.06s/frame (was ~0.005s) — 12x slower
- dRM(32,21) product code: ~20s/frame with 50K queries
- GLDPC eBCH(32,26): ~3s/frame with 5K queries

The paper reports the (1024,441) dRM product code running at ~0.03 fps even with 100K queries. Our throughput needs to be competitive for practical simulation campaigns.

## Tasks

1. Profile ORBGRAND pattern enumeration — identify hotspots in the inner loop (syndrome check, probability accumulation, codeword construction).
2. Profile SOGRAND APP computation — cost scales with list size × n. With ~24 codewords for dRM, this should be fast but verify.
3. Evaluate early-exit strategies that preserve soft-output quality:
   - Exit when cumulative probability exceeds a threshold (e.g., 0.999) AND min list_size is reached
   - Reduce max_queries based on component code properties
4. Consider SIMD acceleration for syndrome checks (batch multiple patterns).
5. Benchmark before/after each optimization.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Profiling report with flamegraph or equivalent identifying top hotspots.
2. At least 3x throughput improvement for eBCH(16,11) product code (back to <0.02s/frame).
3. No regression in BLER (verify with alignment sims at key SNR points).
4. Document recommended max_queries settings for each component code size.
